description: President is elected by the public in a general election per Article 136.
Cabinet Secretaries are appointed by the President with National Assembly approval per Article 152.
Constituency MPs are elected by registered voters per Article 97(1)(a).
Nominated by political parties based on seat proportion per Article 97(1)(c).
Appointed by the President on the recommendation of the JSC per Article 166.
Appointed by President; sits in Cabinet as an ex-officio member per Article 152.
County Governors are elected by voters in the respective county per Article 180.
CECMs are appointed by the Governor with County Assembly approval per Article 179.
Nominated by PSC and appointed by the President per Article 155.
Elected by Senators from among persons who are not members of the Senate per Article 106.
